name: Skin & Hair Rejuvenation
headline: Natural Beauty & Holistic Wellness from Within
intro: Ayurveda believes that true beauty comes from inner balance. Skin and hair problems are often linked to toxins, stress, poor digestion, and hormonal imbalance. With authentic Ayurvedic therapies, herbal medicines, and personalized diets, patients can achieve healthy skin and strong, lustrous hair — naturally and without side effects. International patients often choose Ayurvedic skin & hair care in India for acne, premature aging, pigmentation, psoriasis, eczema, hair fall, dandruff, and premature greying.
